widgets.name: PharmaGuard Risk Dashboard
widgets.description: Displays the clinical safety report with color-coded risk level, patient info, and expandable report body

examples.name: High Risk Example
examples.description: Ibuprofen for Mr. Sharma — drug interaction + elderly flag

data.report:
**Overall Verdict:** DO NOT PRESCRIBE without review.

**Concerns Found:**
- Drug-drug interaction (MAJOR): Ibuprofen + Lisinopril — NSAIDs reduce antihypertensive effect of ACE inhibitors
- Elderly patient (age 65): Consider reduced starting dose per Beers Criteria

**Recommendation:** Consider Acetaminophen as a safer alternative for pain management.

examples.name: Safe Example
examples.description: Acetaminophen for Ms. Fernandez — no safety concerns

data.report:
**Overall Verdict:** SAFE TO PRESCRIBE.

No safety concerns identified. Acetaminophen (Category B) is generally considered safe during pregnancy at standard doses.

**Recommendation:** Proceed with standard prescribing guidelines.
